There was nothing left to feed the flames. They had withdrawn from that space.

There she was.

en.html:
I lifted the fallen girl into my arms.
One look at her condition... and my eyes turned away on their own.

Terrible—
No. Terrible was not enough to call it.

Almost her whole body had been burned to charcoal. From the look of her, how could there be life left?

And yet...

en.html:
At least that much relief I had. I let out a breath.
Then I looked beside her.

Nothing but scrap iron. No other name would fit it.
...Doushin Yusa, the Lord of Koga. Was this his end?

Looking closely, yes, it was the wreckage of a tsurugi. Flesh was mixed in there too. Pieces of human flesh and bone.

必要最低限度の安堵は得て、一つ息をつく。
　そうして、傍らへ目をやった。

　鉄屑以外の何とも呼べない、それ。
　……古河公方、遊佐童心――これがその最後という
事なのか。

　良く観察すれば確かに、それは劒冑の残骸だった。
　肉も――人の骨肉の断片も混ざっている。

en.html:
At her prompting, I stood.
With my uninjured right arm, I lifted Ichijou—half dead, inside her half-destroyed tsurugi.

Enemy ground, this. Every moment was needed for getting out, for reaching somewhere safe.

Still... a few precious moments I spent looking up.
At the sky burning red with the reflected fire, I muttered—

This has become very bad.

ja.html:
促されて、立ち上がる。
　半壊した劒冑に包まれた半死の一条を、無事な右腕
で抱え上げて。

　ここは敵地。寸秒を惜しんで離脱し、安全な所まで
逃れなくてはならない。
　
　だが……俺は貴重な数瞬間を費やして、天を仰いだ。

　炎を映し、紅く燃えている空に向かって呟く。

　――――まずい<ruby>事態<rt>こと</rt></ruby>になった。
